findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：MPS 主要透過第三方經銷商與加值轉售商銷售，2025 年三家經銷商分占營收 26%、18%、10%（2024 年兩家 31%、20%）；經銷協議為非獨家，未見通路結構性轉變的揭露。
findings.excerpt: In 2025, three distributors accounted for 26%, 18% and 10% of our total revenue. In 2024, two distributors accounted for 31% and 20% of our total revenue. In 2023, three distributors accounted for 26%, 19% and 10% of our total revenue.

findings.claim: 二手摘要稱 Q2 2026 營收年增 48%，經銷商通路占營收 88%（未對公司文件核實）。
findings.excerpt: Operational risks also include high reliance on third-party channels, with 88% of sales flowing through distributors. This structure requires careful monitoring of inventory levels to avoid mismatches between channel supply and end-market demand.

note: 兩次搜尋未發現 2026 年通路破壞、D2C、訂閱化或平台化的來源；僅有二手摘要稱經銷占比約 88% 及 CEO 談『從晶片供應商轉向矽基解決方案』，未取得原文故不列入。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
